typedef struct LodePNGColorMode {
	/*header (IHDR)*/
	LodePNGColorType colortype; /*color type, see PNG standard or documentation further in this header file*/
	unsigned bitdepth;  /*bits per sample, see PNG standard or documentation further in this header file*/

	/*
	palette (PLTE and tRNS)

	Dynamically allocated with the colors of the palette, including alpha.
	This field may not be allocated directly, use lodepng_color_mode_init first,
	then lodepng_palette_add per color to correctly initialize it (to ensure size
	of exactly 1024 bytes).

	The alpha channels must be set as well, set them to 255 for opaque images.

	When decoding, by default you can ignore this palette, since LodePNG already
	fills the palette colors in the pixels of the raw RGBA output.

	The palette is only supported for color type 3.
	*/
	unsigned char* palette; /*palette in RGBARGBA... order. Must be either 0, or when allocated must have 1024 bytes*/
	size_t palettesize; /*palette size in number of colors (amount of used bytes is 4 * palettesize)*/

	/*
	transparent color key (tRNS)

	This color uses the same bit depth as the bitdepth value in this struct, which can be 1-bit to 16-bit.
	For grayscale PNGs, r, g and b will all 3 be set to the same.

	When decoding, by default you can ignore this information, since LodePNG sets
	pixels with this key to transparent already in the raw RGBA output.

	The color key is only supported for color types 0 and 2.
	*/
	unsigned key_defined; /*is a transparent color key given? 0 = false, 1 = true*/
	unsigned key_r;       /*red/grayscale component of color key*/
	unsigned key_g;       /*green component of color key*/
	unsigned key_b;       /*blue component of color key*/
} LodePNGColorMode;

class Units { // contains the 4 base units [m], [kg], [s], [K] for unit conversions and vtk output
private:
	float unit_m=1.0f, unit_kg=1.0f, unit_s=1.0f, unit_K=1.0f; // 1 lattice unit times [m]/[kg]/[s]/[K] is [meter]/[kilogram]/[second]/[Kelvin]
public:
	void set_m_kg_s(const float x, const float u, const float rho/*=1.0f*/, const float si_x, const float si_u, const float si_rho) { // length x, velocity u, density rho in both simulation and SI units
		unit_m = si_x/x; // length si_x = x*[m]
		unit_kg = si_rho/rho*cb(unit_m); // density si_rho = rho*[kg/m^3]
		unit_s = u/si_u*unit_m; // velocity si_u = u*[m/s]
		print_info("Unit Conversion: 1 cell = "+to_string(1000.0f*this->si_x(1.0f), 3u)+" mm, 1 s = "+to_string(this->t(1.0f))+" time steps");
	}
	void set_m_kg_s(const float m, const float kg, const float s) { // do unit conversion manually
		this->unit_m = m;
		this->unit_kg = kg;
		this->unit_s = s;
		print_info("Unit Conversion: 1 cell = "+to_string(1000.0f*this->si_x(1.0f), 3u)+" mm, 1 s = "+to_string(this->t(1.0f))+" time steps");
	}
	void set_m_kg_s_K(const float x, const float u, const float rho/*=1.0f*/, const float T/*=1.0f*/, const float si_x, const float si_u, const float si_rho, const float si_T) { // length x, velocity u, density rho, temperature T in both simulation and SI units
		unit_m = si_x/x; // length si_x = x*[m]
		unit_kg = si_rho/rho*cb(unit_m); // density si_rho = rho*[kg/m^3]
		unit_s = u/si_u*unit_m; // velocity si_u = u*[m/s]
		unit_K = si_T/T; // length si_T = T*[K]
		print_info("Unit Conversion: 1 cell = "+to_string(1000.0f*this->si_x(1.0f), 3u)+" mm, 1 s = "+to_string(this->t(1.0f))+" time steps");
	}
	void set_m_kg_s_K(const float m, const float kg, const float s, const float K) { // do unit conversion manually
		this->unit_m = m;
		this->unit_kg = kg;
		this->unit_s = s;
		this->unit_K = K;
		print_info("Unit Conversion: 1 cell = "+to_string(1000.0f*this->si_x(1.0f), 3u)+" mm, 1 s = "+to_string(this->t(1.0f))+" time steps");
	}

	// the following methods convert SI units into simulation units (have to be called after set_m_kg_s(...);)
	float x(const float si_x) const { return si_x/unit_m; } // length si_x = x*[m]
	float m(const float si_m) const { return si_m/unit_kg; } // mass si_m = m*[kg]
	ulong t(const float si_t) const { return to_ulong(si_t/unit_s); } // time si_t = t*[s]
	float frequency(const float si_frequency) const { return si_frequency*unit_s; } // frequency si_frequency = frequency*[1/s]
	float omega(const float si_omega) const { return si_omega*unit_s; } // frequency si_omega = omega/[s]
	float u(const float si_u) const { return si_u*unit_s/unit_m; } // velocity si_u = u*[m/s]
	float rho(const float si_rho) const { return si_rho*cb(unit_m)/unit_kg; } // density si_rho = rho*[kg/m^3]
	float Q(const float si_Q) const { return si_Q*unit_s/cb(unit_m); } // flow rate si_Q = Q*[m^3/s]
	float nu(const float si_nu) const { return si_nu*unit_s/sq(unit_m); } // kinematic shear viscosity si_nu = nu*[m^2/s]
	float mu(const float si_mu) const { return si_mu*unit_s*unit_m/unit_kg; } // dynamic shear viscosity si_mu = mu*[kg/(m*s)]
	float g(const float si_g) const { return si_g/unit_m*sq(unit_s); } // gravitational acceleration si_g = g*[m/s^2]
	float f(const float si_f) const { return si_f*sq(unit_m*unit_s)/unit_kg; } // force per volume si_f = f*[kg/(m*s)^2]
	float f(const float si_rho, const float si_g) const { return si_rho*si_g*sq(unit_m*unit_s)/unit_kg; } // force per volume f = rho*g = si_rho/[kg/m^3]*si_g/[m/s^2] = si_rho*si_g*[(m*s)^2/kg]
	float F(const float si_F) const { return si_F*sq(unit_s)/(unit_kg*unit_m); } // force si_F = F*[kg*m/s^2]
	float M(const float si_M) const { return si_M*sq(unit_s)/(unit_kg*sq(unit_m)); } // torque si_M = M*[kg*m^2/s^2]
	float sigma(const float si_sigma) const { return si_sigma*sq(unit_s)/unit_kg; } // surface tension si_sigma = sigma*[kg/s^2]
	float T(const float si_T) { return si_T/unit_K; } // temperature si_T = T*[K]
	float alpha(const float si_alpha) { return si_alpha*unit_s/sq(unit_m); } // thermal diffusion coefficient si_alpha = alpha*[m^2/s]
	float beta(const float si_beta) { return si_beta*unit_K; } // (volumetric) thermal expansion coefficient si_beta = beta*[1/K]

	// the following methods convert simulation units into SI units (have to be called after set_m_kg_s(...);)
	float si_x(const uint x) const { return (float)x*unit_m; } // length si_x = x*[m]
	float si_x(const float x) const { return x*unit_m; } // length si_x = x*[m]
	float si_m(const float m) const { return m*unit_kg; } // mass si_m = m*[kg]
	float si_t(const ulong t) const { return (float)t*unit_s; } // time si_t = t*[s]
	float si_frequency(const float frequency) const { return frequency/unit_s; } // frequency si_frequency = frequency*[1/s]
	float si_V(const float V) const { return V*cb(unit_m); } // volume si_V = V*[m^3]
	float si_u(const float u) const { return u*unit_m/unit_s; } // velocity si_u = u*[m/s]
	float si_rho(const float rho) const { return rho*unit_kg/cb(unit_m); } // density si_rho = rho*[kg/m^3]
	float si_p(const float p) const { return p*unit_kg/(unit_m*sq(unit_s)); } // pressure si_p = p*[kg/(m*s^2)] = p*[Pa]
	float si_Q(const float Q) const { return Q*cb(unit_m)/unit_s; } // flow rate si_Q = Q*[m^3/s]
	float si_nu(const float nu) const { return nu*sq(unit_m)/unit_s; } // kinematic shear viscosity si_nu = nu*[m^2/s]
	float si_g(const float g) const { return g*unit_m/sq(unit_s); } // gravitational acceleration si_g = g*[m/s^2]
	float si_f(const float f) const { return f*unit_kg/sq(unit_m*unit_s); } // force per volume si_f = f*[kg/(m*s)^2]
	float si_F(const float F) const { return F*unit_kg*unit_m/sq(unit_s); } // force si_F = F*[kg*m/s^2]
	float si_M(const float M) const { return M*unit_kg*sq(unit_m)/sq(unit_s); } // torque si_M = M*[kg*m^2/s^2]
	float si_sigma(const float sigma) const { return sigma*unit_kg/sq(unit_s); } // surface tension si_sigma = sigma*[kg/s^2]
	float si_T(const float T) { return T*unit_K; } // temperature si_T = T*[K]
	float si_alpha(const float alpha) { return alpha*sq(unit_m)/unit_s; } // thermal diffusion coefficient si_alpha = alpha*[m^2/s]
	float si_beta(const float beta) { return beta/unit_K; } // (volumetric) thermal expansion coefficient si_beta = beta*[1/K]

	// other conversions in simulation units (can be called before set_m_kg_s(...);)
	float Re(const float si_Re) const { return si_Re; } // Reynolds number Re = x*u/nu = [1] no unit
	float Re(const float x, const float u, const float nu) const { return x*u/nu; } // Reynolds number Re = x*u/nu = [1] no unit
	float Re(const float x, const float u, const float mu, const float rho) const { return x*u*rho/mu; } // Reynolds number Re = x*u*rho/mu = [1] no unit
	float We(const float x, const float u, const float rho, const float sigma) const { return x*sq(u)*rho/sigma; } // Weber number We = x*u^2*rho/sigma = [1] no unit
	float Fr(const float x, const float u, const float g) const { return u/sqrt(x*g); } // Froude number Fr = u/sqrt(x*g) = [1] no unit
	float Ca(const float u, const float mu, const float sigma) const { return u*mu/sigma; } // Capillary number Ca = u*mu/sigma = [1] no unit
	float Ca(const float u, const float rho, const float nu, const float sigma) const { return u*rho*nu/sigma; } // Capillary number Ca = u*rho*nu/sigma = [1] no unit
	float Bo(const float x, const float rho, const float g, const float sigma) const { return sq(x)*rho*g/sigma; } // Bond number Bo = x^2*rho*g/sigma = [1] no unit
	float Mo(const float rho, const float delta_rho, const float g, const float sigma, const float mu) const { return g*delta_rho*sq(sq(mu))/(cb(sigma)*sq(rho)); } // Morton number g*delta_rho*mu^4/(sigma^3*rho^2)
	float Ga(const float x, const float nu, const float g) { return cb(x)*g/sq(nu); } // Galilei number Ga = x^3*g/nu^2 = [1] no unit
	float Ga(const float x, const float rho, const float nu, const float f) { return cb(x)*f/(sq(nu)*rho); } // Galilei number Ga = x^3*g/nu^2 = [1] no unit
	float Ma(const float u) const { return u/0.57735027f; } // Mach number Ma = u/c = [1] no unit, c = 1/sqrt(3) is lattice speed of sound
	float p_from_rho(const float rho) const { return (rho-1.0f)/3.0f; } // pressure p = (rho-rho0)*c^2 = (rho-1)/3 = [kg/(m*s^2)] = [Pa], rho is density, c = 1/sqrt(3) is lattice speed of sound
	float rho_from_p(const float p) const { return 1.0f+3.0f*p; } // density rho = p0/c^2+p/c^2 = 1+3*p = [kg/m^3], p is pressure, c = 1/sqrt(3) is lattice speed of sound
	float rho_laplace(const float sigma, const float R) { return 6.0f*sigma/R; } // sphere laplace pressure p = 2*sigma/R, density rho = 3*p
	float rho_hydrostatic(const float f, const float z, const float h) { return 3.0f*f*(h-z)+1.0f; } // hydrostatic pressure p = rho*g*h+p0 = f*h+1/3, density rho = 3*p, force per volume f = rho*g, rho0 = 1
	float nu_from_mu(const float mu, const float rho) const { return mu/rho; } // kinematic shear viscosity nu = mu/rho = [m^2/s]
	float nu_from_tau(const float tau) const { return (tau-0.5f)/3.0f; } // kinematic shear viscosity nu = (tau-1/2)/3 = [m^2/s], LBM relaxation time tau
	float nu_from_Re(const float Re, const float x, const float u) const { return x*u/Re; } // kinematic shear viscosity nu = x*u/Re = [m^2/s]
	float f_from_F(const float F, const float V) const { return F/V; } // force per volume f = F/V = [kg/(m*s)^2]
	float f_from_g(const float g, const float rho) const { return rho*g; } // force per volume f = rho*g = [kg/(m*s)^2]
	float g_from_f(const float f, const float rho) const { return f/rho; } // force per volume f = rho*g = [kg/(m*s)^2]
	float u_from_Re(const float Re, const float x, const float nu) const { return Re*nu/x; } // velocity u = Re*nu/x, Reynolds number Re = x*u/nu = [1] no unit
	float u_from_Re(const float Re, const float x, const float mu, const float rho) const { return Re*mu/(x*rho); } // velocity u = Re*nu/x, Reynolds number Re = x*u*rho/mu = [1] no unit
	float u_from_Ma(const float Ma) const { return 0.57735027f*Ma; } // velocity u = c*Ma, Mach number Ma = u/c = [1] no unit, c = 1/sqrt(3) is lattice speed of sound
	float u_from_We(const float We, const float x, const float sigma, const float rho) const { return sqrt(We*sigma/(x*rho)); } // velocity u = sqrt(We*sigma/(x*rho)) = [m/s], Weber number We = x*u^2*rho/sigma = [1] no unit
	float u_from_Fr(const float Fr, const float x, const float g) const { return Fr*sqrt(x*g); } // velocity u = Fr*sqrt(x*g) = [m/s], Froude number Fr = u/sqrt(x*g) = [1] no unit
	float u_from_Ca(const float Ca, const float sigma, const float nu, const float rho) const { return Ca*sigma/(rho*nu); } // velocity u = Ca*sigma/(rho*nu) = [m/s], Capillary number Ca = u*rho*nu/sigma = [1] no unit
	float u_from_Ca(const float Ca, const float sigma, const float mu) const { return Ca*sigma/mu; } // velocity u = Ca*sigma/(rho*nu) = [m/s], Capillary number Ca = u*mu/sigma = [1] no unit
	float u_from_f_Poiseuille_2D(const float f, const float rho, const float nu, const float R) const { return f*sq(R)/(2.0f*rho*nu); } // center velocity in 2D Poiseuille flow in channel u = f/(2*rho*nu)*R^2, force per volume f = 2*u*rho*nu/R^2
	float u_from_f_Poiseuille_3D(const float f, const float rho, const float nu, const float R) const { return f*sq(R)/(4.0f*rho*nu); } // center velocity in 3D Poiseuille flow in channel u = f/(4*rho*nu)*R^2, force per volume f = 4*u*rho*nu/R^2
	float u_from_f_Poiseuille_2D(const float Q, const float R) const { return 0.75f*Q/R; } // center velocity in 2D Poiseuille flow in channel u = 3/4*Q/R, force per volume f = 2*u*rho*nu/R^2, flow rate Q = 2/3*f*R^3/(rho*nu) = 4/3*u*R
	float u_from_f_Poiseuille_3D(const float Q, const float R) const { return 2.0f/pif*Q/sq(R); } // center velocity in 3D Poiseuille flow in channel u = 2/pi*Q/R^2, force per volume f = 4*u*rho*nu/R^2, flow rate Q = pi/8*f*R^4/(rho*nu) = pi/2*R^2*u
	float f_from_u_Poiseuille_2D(const float u, const float rho, const float nu, const float R) const { return 2.0f*u*rho*nu/sq(R); } // force per volume for 2D Poiseuille flow f = 2*u*rho*nu/R^2, u is center velocity, R is channel radius
	float f_from_u_Poiseuille_3D(const float u, const float rho, const float nu, const float R) const { return 4.0f*u*rho*nu/sq(R); } // force per volume for 3D Poiseuille flow in cylinder f = 4*u*rho*nu/R^2, u is center velocity, R is cylinder radius
	float f_from_u_rectangular_duct(const float w, const float h, const float rho, const float nu, const float u) { // force per volume f from center velocity u in rectangular channel with (-w/2<=y<=w/2, -h/2<=z<=h/2)
		const int N = 23u; // ux will become NaN for N>23 due to cosh(x) blowing up
		const double A = (cb(pi)*(double)rho*(double)nu*(double)u)/(4.0*sq((double)h));
		const double piw2h=pi*0.5*(double)w/(double)h, pi2=pi*0.5;
		double sum = 0.0;
		for(int i=2*N-1; i>=1; i-=2) { // calculate terms in reverse (smallest first) to mitigate numerical loss of significance
			const double n = (double)i;
			sum += (1.0-1.0/cosh(n*piw2h))/cb(n)*sin(n*pi2);
		}
		return (float)(A/sum); // u = A*sum
	}
	float3 u_Stokes(const float3& x, const float3& u0, const float R) const { // returns velocity at point x for laminar flow with velocity u0 around stationary sphere with radius R in origin
		const float r=1.0f/length(x), r3=cb(r), r5=sq(r)*r3, R2=sq(R);
		return u0-(1.0f/r>R ? (u0*(r+R2*r3/3.0f)+x*dot(u0, x)*(r3-R2*r5))*0.75f*R : u0);
	}
	float rho_Stokes(const float3& x, const float3& u0, const float R, const float rho, const float nu) const { // returns density at point x for laminar flow with velocity u0 around stationary sphere with radius R in origin
		const float r = length(x);
		return r>R ? rho-4.5f*rho*nu*R*dot(u0, x)/cb(r) : rho;
	}
	float f_Stokes(const float rho, const float u, const float nu, const float R, const float V) const { return 6.0f*pif*rho*nu*R*u/V; } // returns Stokes drag force density for laminar flow past stationary sphere with radius R in fluid volume V, F = 6*pi*mu*R*u, f = F/V
	float F_Stokes(const float rho, const float u, const float nu, const float R) const { return 6.0f*pif*rho*nu*R*u; } // returns Stokes drag force for laminar flow past stationary sphere with radius R, F = 6*pi*mu*R*u

	// other conversions in SI units (can be called before set_m_kg_s(...);)
	float si_Re(const float Re) const { return Re; } // Reynolds number Re = x*u/nu = [1] no unit
	float si_Re(const float si_x, const float si_u, const float si_nu) const { return si_x*si_u/si_nu; } // Reynolds number Re = x*u/nu = [1] no unit
	float si_Re(const float si_x, const float si_u, const float si_mu, const float si_rho) const { return si_x*si_u*si_rho/si_mu; } // Reynolds number Re = x*u*rho/mu = [1] no unit
	float si_We(const float si_x, const float si_u, const float si_rho, const float si_sigma) const { return si_x*sq(si_u)*si_rho/si_sigma; } // Weber number We = x*u^2*rho/sigma = [1] no unit
	float si_Fr(const float si_x, const float si_u, const float si_g) const { return si_u/sqrt(si_x*si_g); } // Froude number Fr = u/sqrt(x*g) = [1] no unit
	float si_Ca(const float si_u, const float si_mu, const float si_sigma) const { return si_u*si_mu/si_sigma; } // Capillary number Ca = u*mu/sigma = [1] no unit
	float si_Ca(const float si_u, const float si_rho, const float si_nu, const float si_sigma) const { return si_u*si_rho*si_nu/si_sigma; } // Capillary number Ca = u*rho*nu/sigma = [1] no unit
	float si_Bo(const float si_x, const float si_rho, const float si_g, const float si_sigma) const { return sq(si_x)*si_rho*si_g/si_sigma; } // Bond number Bo = x^2*rho*g/sigma = [1] no unit

	float si_nu_from_si_mu(const float si_mu, const float si_rho) const { return si_mu/si_rho; } // kinematic shear viscosity nu = mu/rho = [m^2/s]
	float si_nu_from_si_Re(const float si_Re, const float si_x, const float si_u) const { return si_x*si_u/si_Re; } // kinematic shear viscosity nu = x*u/Re = [m^2/s]
	float si_mu_from_si_nu(const float si_nu, const float si_rho) const { return si_nu*si_rho; } // dynamic viscosity mu = nu*rho = [kg/(m*s)]
	float si_f_from_si_g(const float si_g, const float si_rho) const { return si_rho*si_g; } // force per volume f = rho*g = [kg/(m*s)^2]
	float si_g_from_si_f(const float si_f, const float si_rho) const { return si_f/si_rho; } // force per volume f = rho*g = [kg/(m*s)^2]
	float si_u_from_si_Re(const float si_Re, const float si_x, const float si_nu) const { return si_Re*si_nu/si_x; } // velocity u = Re*nu/x, Reynolds number Re = x*u/nu = [1] no unit
	float si_u_from_si_Re(const float si_Re, const float si_x, const float si_mu, const float si_rho) const { return si_Re*si_mu/(si_x*si_rho); } // velocity u = Re*nu/x, Reynolds number Re = x*u*rho/mu = [1] no unit
	float si_u_from_si_We(const float si_We, const float si_x, const float si_sigma, const float si_rho) const { return sqrt(si_We*si_sigma/(si_x*si_rho)); } // velocity u = sqrt(We*sigma/(x*rho)) = [m/s], Weber number We = x*u^2*rho/sigma = [1] no unit

	float si_u_Poiseuille_3D(const float si_Q, const float si_R) const { return 2.0f/pif*si_Q/sq(si_R); } // center velocity in 3D Poiseuille flow in channel u = 2/pi*Q/R^2, force per volume f = 4*u*rho*nu/R^2, flow rate Q = pi/8*f*R^4/(rho*nu) = pi/2*R^2*u

class LBM_Domain {
private:
	uint Nx=1u, Ny=1u, Nz=1u; // (local) lattice dimensions
	uint Dx=1u, Dy=1u, Dz=1u; // lattice domains
	int Ox=0, Oy=0, Oz=0; // lattice domain offset
	ulong t = 0ull; // discrete time step in LBM units

	float nu = 1.0f/6.0f; // kinematic shear viscosity
	float fx=0.0f, fy=0.0f, fz=0.0f; // global force per volume
	float sigma=0.0f; // surface tension coefficient
	float alpha=1.0f, beta=1.0f, T_avg=1.0f; // alpha = thermal diffusion coefficient, beta = (volumetric) thermal expansion coefficient, T_avg = 1 = average temperature
	uint particles_N = 0u;
	float particles_rho = 1.0f;

	Device device; // OpenCL device associated with this LBM domain
	Kernel kernel_initialize; // initialization kernel
	Kernel kernel_stream_collide; // main LBM kernel
	Kernel kernel_update_fields; // reads DDFs and updates (rho, u, T) in device memory
	Memory<fpxx> fi; // LBM density distribution functions (DDFs); only exist in device memory
	ulong t_last_update_fields = max_ulong; // optimization to not call kernel_update_fields multiple times if (rho, u, T) are already up-to-date
#ifdef FORCE_FIELD
	Kernel kernel_update_force_field; // calculate forces from fluid on TYPE_S cells
	Kernel kernel_reset_force_field; // reset force field (also on TYPE_S cells)
	Kernel kernel_object_center_of_mass; // calculate center of mass of all cells flagged with flag_marker
	Kernel kernel_object_force; // add up force for all cells flagged with flag_marker
	Kernel kernel_object_torque; // add up torque around specified rotation_center for all cells flagged with flag_marker
	ulong t_last_force_field = max_ulong; // optimization to not call kernel_update_force_field multiple times if F is already up-to-date
#endif // FORCE_FIELD
#ifdef MOVING_BOUNDARIES
	Kernel kernel_update_moving_boundaries; // mark/unmark cells next to TYPE_S cells with velocity!=0 with TYPE_MS
#endif // MOVING_BOUNDARIES
#ifdef SURFACE
	Kernel kernel_surface_0; // additional kernel for computing mass conservation and mass flux computation
	Kernel kernel_surface_1; // additional kernel for flag handling
	Kernel kernel_surface_2; // additional kernel for flag handling
	Kernel kernel_surface_3; // additional kernel for flag handling and mass conservation
	Memory<float> mass; // fluid mass; phi=mass/rho
	Memory<float> massex; // excess mass; used for mass conservation
#endif // SURFACE
#ifdef TEMPERATURE
	Memory<fpxx> gi; // thermal DDFs
#endif // TEMPERATURE
#ifdef PARTICLES
	Kernel kernel_integrate_particles; // intgegrates particles forward in time and couples particles to fluid
#endif // PARTICLES

	void allocate(Device& device); // allocate all memory for data fields on host and device and set up kernels
	string device_defines() const; // returns preprocessor constants for embedding in OpenCL C code

public:
	Memory<float> rho; // density of every cell
	Memory<float> u; // velocity of every cell
	Memory<uchar> flags; // flags of every cell
#ifdef FORCE_FIELD
	Memory<float> F; // individual force for every cell
	Memory<float> object_sum; // sum of individual cell data for an object
#endif // FORCE_FIELD
#ifdef SURFACE
	Memory<float> phi; // fill level of every cell
#endif // SURFACE
#ifdef TEMPERATURE
	Memory<float> T; // temperature of every cell
#endif // TEMPERATURE
#ifdef PARTICLES
	Memory<float> particles; // particle positions
#endif // PARTICLES

	Memory<char> transfer_buffer_p, transfer_buffer_m; // transfer buffers for multi-device domain communication, only allocate one set of transfer buffers in plus/minus directions, for all x/y/z transfers
	Kernel kernel_transfer[enum_transfer_field::enum_transfer_field_length][2]; // for each field one extract and one insert kernel
	void allocate_transfer(Device& device); // allocate all memory for multi-device transfer
	ulong get_area(const uint direction);
	void enqueue_transfer_extract_field(Kernel& kernel_transfer_extract_field, const uint direction, const uint bytes_per_cell);
	void enqueue_transfer_insert_field(Kernel& kernel_transfer_insert_field, const uint direction, const uint bytes_per_cell);

	LBM_Domain(const Device_Info& device_info, const uint Nx, const uint Ny, const uint Nz, const uint Dx, const uint Dy, const uint Dz, const int Ox, const int Oy, const int Oz, const float nu, const float fx, const float fy, const float fz, const float sigma, const float alpha, const float beta, const uint particles_N, const float particles_rho); // compiles OpenCL C code and allocates memory

	void enqueue_initialize(); // write all data fields to device and call kernel_initialize
	void enqueue_stream_collide(); // call kernel_stream_collide to perform one LBM time step
	void enqueue_update_fields(); // update fields (rho, u, T) manually
#ifdef SURFACE
	void enqueue_surface_0();
	void enqueue_surface_1();
	void enqueue_surface_2();
	void enqueue_surface_3();
#endif // SURFACE
#ifdef FORCE_FIELD
	void enqueue_update_force_field(); // calculate forces from fluid on TYPE_S cells
	void enqueue_object_center_of_mass(const uchar flag_marker=TYPE_S); // calculate center of mass of all cells flagged with flag_marker
	void enqueue_object_force(const uchar flag_marker=TYPE_S); // add up force for all cells flagged with flag_marker
	void enqueue_object_torque(const float3& rotation_center, const uchar flag_marker=TYPE_S); // add up torque around specified rotation_center for all cells flagged with flag_marker
#endif // FORCE_FIELD
#ifdef MOVING_BOUNDARIES
	void enqueue_update_moving_boundaries(); // mark/unmark cells next to TYPE_S cells with velocity!=0 with TYPE_MS
#endif // MOVING_BOUNDARIES
#ifdef PARTICLES
	void enqueue_integrate_particles(const uint time_step_multiplicator=1u); // intgegrates particles forward in time and couples particles to fluid
#endif // PARTICLES

	void increment_time_step(const uint steps=1u); // increment time step
	void reset_time_step(); // reset time step
	void finish_queue();

	const Device& get_device() const { return device; }
	uint get_Nx() const { return Nx; } // get (local) lattice dimensions in x-direction
	uint get_Ny() const { return Ny; } // get (local) lattice dimensions in y-direction
	uint get_Nz() const { return Nz; } // get (local) lattice dimensions in z-direction
	ulong get_N() const { return (ulong)Nx*(ulong)Ny*(ulong)Nz; } // get (local) number of lattice points
	uint get_Dx() const { return Dx; } // get lattice domains in x-direction
	uint get_Dy() const { return Dy; } // get lattice domains in y-direction
	uint get_Dz() const { return Dz; } // get lattice domains in z-direction
	uint get_D() const { return Dx*Dy*Dz; } // get number of lattice domains
	float get_nu() const { return nu; } // get kinematic shear viscosity
	float get_tau() const { return 3.0f*get_nu()+0.5f; } // get LBM relaxation time
	float get_fx() const { return fx; } // get global froce per volume
	float get_fy() const { return fy; } // get global froce per volume
	float get_fz() const { return fz; } // get global froce per volume
	float get_sigma() const { return sigma; } // get surface tension coefficient
	float get_alpha() const { return alpha; } // get thermal diffusion coefficient
	float get_beta() const { return beta; } // get thermal expansion coefficient
	ulong get_t() const { return t; } // get discrete time step in LBM units
	uint get_velocity_set() const; // get LBM velocity set
	void set_fx(const float fx) { this->fx = fx; } // set global froce per volume
	void set_fy(const float fy) { this->fy = fy; } // set global froce per volume
	void set_fz(const float fz) { this->fz = fz; } // set global froce per volume
	void set_f(const float fx, const float fy, const float fz) { set_fx(fx); set_fy(fy); set_fz(fz); } // set global froce per volume

	void voxelize_mesh_on_device(const Mesh* mesh, const uchar flag=TYPE_S, const float3& rotation_center=float3(0.0f), const float3& linear_velocity=float3(0.0f), const float3& rotational_velocity=float3(0.0f)); // voxelize mesh
	void enqueue_unvoxelize_mesh_on_device(const Mesh* mesh, const uchar flag=TYPE_S); // remove voxelized triangle mesh from LBM grid

#ifdef GRAPHICS
	class Graphics {
	private:
		Kernel kernel_clear; // reset bitmap and zbuffer
		Memory<int> bitmap; // bitmap for rendering
		Memory<int> zbuffer; // z-buffer for rendering
		Memory<float> camera_parameters; // contains camera position, rotation, field of view etc.

		LBM_Domain* lbm = nullptr;
		Kernel kernel_graphics_flags; // render flag lattice with wireframe
		Kernel kernel_graphics_flags_mc; // render flag lattice with marching-cubes
		Kernel kernel_graphics_field; // render a colored velocity vector for each cell
		Kernel kernel_graphics_field_slice; // render one slice of velocity field according to slics settings
		Kernel kernel_graphics_streamline; // render streamlines
		Kernel kernel_graphics_q; // render vorticity (Q-criterion)

#ifdef SURFACE
		const string path_skybox = get_exe_path()+"../skybox/skybox8k.png";
		Image* skybox_image = nullptr;
		Memory<int> skybox; // skybox for free surface raytracing
		Kernel kernel_graphics_rasterize_phi; // rasterize free surface
		Kernel kernel_graphics_raytrace_phi; // raytrace free surface
		Image* get_skybox_image() const { return skybox_image; }
#endif // SURFACE

#ifdef PARTICLES
		Kernel kernel_graphics_particles;
#endif // PARTICLES

		ulong t_last_rendered_frame = max_ulong; // optimization to not call draw_frame() multiple times if camera_parameters and LBM time step are unchanged
		bool update_camera(); // update camera_parameters and return if they are changed from their previous state

	public:
		Graphics() {} // default constructor
		Graphics(LBM_Domain* lbm) {
			this->lbm = lbm;
#ifdef SURFACE
			skybox_image = read_png(path_skybox);
#endif // SURFACE
		}
		Graphics& operator=(const Graphics& graphics) { // copy assignment
			lbm = graphics.lbm;
#ifdef SURFACE
			skybox_image = graphics.get_skybox_image();
#endif // SURFACE
			return *this;
		}
		void allocate(Device& device); // allocate memory for bitmap and zbuffer
		bool enqueue_draw_frame(const int visualization_modes, const int field_mode=0, const int slice_mode=0, const int slice_x=0, const int slice_y=0, const int slice_z=0, const bool visualization_change=true); // main rendering function, calls rendering kernels, returns true if new frame is rendered, false if old frame is returned when camera has not moved
		int* get_bitmap(); // returns pointer to bitmap
		int* get_zbuffer(); // returns pointer to zbuffer
		string device_defines() const; // returns preprocessor constants for embedding in OpenCL C code
	}; // Graphics
	Graphics graphics;
#endif // GRAPHICS
}; // LBM_Domain

functions.name: lodepng_decode_memory
functions.signature: unsigned lodepng_decode_memory(unsigned char** out, unsigned* w, unsigned* h, const unsigned char* in, size_t insize, LodePNGColorType colortype, unsigned bitdepth)
functions.description: Decodes a PNG image from a memory buffer into raw pixel data with the requested color type and bit depth. On success, allocates *out and writes width/height to w/h. For 16-bit per channel output, the data is big-endian. Returns 0 on success or a LodePNG error code.
requirements: out must be a valid pointer to an unsigned char*; function allocates *out and caller must free(*out) after use.
w and h must be valid pointers to receive dimensions.
in must point to a PNG file in memory and insize must be its size in bytes.
colortype and bitdepth specify the desired raw output format; only supported conversions are allowed (errors otherwise).
For 16-bit per channel output, consumers must handle big-endian samples.
Bytes per pixel of output equals the requested color model; output buffer size is w*h*(bytes per pixel).
Function returns a LodePNG error code; callers should check non-zero for failure.

requirements: out, w, h must be valid pointers; function allocates *out which must be freed by caller.

Returns LodePNG error code.

functions.name: lodepng_encode32_file
functions.signature: unsigned lodepng_encode32_file(const char* filename, const unsigned char* image, unsigned w, unsigned h)
functions.description: Encodes an RGBA8 raw image to a PNG file on disk. Overwrites existing file without warning. Returns 0 on success.
requirements: Requires LODEPNG_COMPILE_DISK.
filename must be writable; existing file will be overwritten.
image must be at least w*h*4 bytes (RGBA8).
w and h are pixel dimensions.
Returns LodePNG error code.

functions.name: lodepng_encode24_file
functions.signature: unsigned lodepng_encode24_file(const char* filename, const unsigned char* image, unsigned w, unsigned h)
functions.description: Encodes an RGB8 raw image to a PNG file on disk. Overwrites existing file without warning. Returns 0 on success.
requirements: Requires LODEPNG_COMPILE_DISK.
filename must be writable; overwrite occurs without warning.
image must be at least w*h*3 bytes (RGB8).
w and h are pixel dimensions.
Returns LodePNG error code.

functions.name: lodepng_error_text
functions.signature: const char* lodepng_error_text(unsigned code)
functions.description: Returns a human-readable English description for a LodePNG numerical error code.
requirements: code is a LodePNG error code returned by library functions.
Return is a pointer to static text; do not free or modify.

functions.name: lodepng_decompress_settings_init
functions.signature: void lodepng_decompress_settings_init(LodePNGDecompressSettings* settings)
functions.description: Initializes a LodePNGDecompressSettings struct to default values, including checksum-ignoring flags and custom function pointers set to defaults.
requirements: settings must be a valid pointer to an allocated LodePNGDecompressSettings.

functions.name: lodepng_compress_settings_init
functions.signature: void lodepng_compress_settings_init(LodePNGCompressSettings* settings)
functions.description: Initializes a LodePNGCompressSettings struct with default compression parameters and custom callbacks set to defaults.
requirements: settings must be a valid pointer to an allocated LodePNGCompressSettings.

functions.name: lodepng_color_mode_init
functions.signature: void lodepng_color_mode_init(LodePNGColorMode* info)
functions.description: Initializes a LodePNGColorMode to a default empty state (no palette, default color settings).
requirements: info must be a valid pointer to LodePNGColorMode.
Call before using the struct; if reinitializing, ensure prior palette is cleaned with lodepng_color_mode_cleanup to avoid leaks.

functions.name: lodepng_color_mode_cleanup
functions.signature: void lodepng_color_mode_cleanup(LodePNGColorMode* info)
functions.description: Cleans up dynamic allocations owned by a LodePNGColorMode (e.g., palette).
requirements: info must be a valid pointer.
After cleanup, do not use freed pointers (e.g., palette) without reinit.

functions.name: lodepng_color_mode_copy
functions.signature: unsigned lodepng_color_mode_copy(LodePNGColorMode* dest, const LodePNGColorMode* source)
functions.description: Copies a LodePNGColorMode from source to dest, allocating palette if needed. Returns 0 on success or error code.
requirements: dest and source must be valid pointers.
dest will have allocations as needed; caller must later cleanup dest with lodepng_color_mode_cleanup.
Returns LodePNG error code on allocation failure.

functions.name: lodepng_color_mode_make
functions.signature: LodePNGColorMode lodepng_color_mode_make(LodePNGColorType colortype, unsigned bitdepth)
functions.description: Creates a temporary LodePNGColorMode with specified color type and bit depth and no palette. The returned value requires no cleanup.
requirements: colortype and bitdepth must form a valid PNG color mode (library may validate when used).

functions.name: lodepng_palette_clear
functions.signature: void lodepng_palette_clear(LodePNGColorMode* info)
functions.description: Clears and deallocates the palette of a LodePNGColorMode and resets palette size to zero.
requirements: info must be a valid pointer to a LodePNGColorMode.
Any previous palette memory will be freed; subsequent palette access requires re-adding colors.

functions.name: lodepng_palette_add
functions.signature: unsigned lodepng_palette_add(LodePNGColorMode* info, unsigned char r, unsigned char g, unsigned char b, unsigned char a)
functions.description: Appends a single RGBA color to the color mode's palette, allocating/updating the internal palette. Returns 0 on success or error code.
requirements: info must be initialized (lodepng_color_mode_init) and valid.
Only valid for palette color type usage (LCT_PALETTE).
Palette capacity is up to 256 entries; exceeding may return error.
Caller should ensure alpha is set appropriately (255 for opaque).
Returns error code on allocation failure or invalid state.

functions.name: lodepng_get_bpp
functions.signature: unsigned lodepng_get_bpp(const LodePNGColorMode* info)
functions.description: Returns bits per pixel for a given color mode (channels*bitdepth or palette index bits).
requirements: info must be a valid pointer.
For LCT_PALETTE, bpp depends on palette index bit depth (1,2,4,8).

functions.name: lodepng_get_channels
functions.signature: unsigned lodepng_get_channels(const LodePNGColorMode* info)
functions.description: Returns the number of color channels implied by color type (palette counts as 1 channel).
requirements: info must be a valid pointer.

functions.name: lodepng_is_greyscale_type
functions.signature: unsigned lodepng_is_greyscale_type(const LodePNGColorMode* info)
functions.description: Returns non-zero if the color mode is grayscale (LCT_GREY or LCT_GREY_ALPHA).
requirements: info must be a valid pointer.

functions.name: lodepng_is_alpha_type
functions.signature: unsigned lodepng_is_alpha_type(const LodePNGColorMode* info)
functions.description: Returns non-zero if the color mode has an alpha channel (LCT_RGBA or LCT_GREY_ALPHA).
requirements: info must be a valid pointer.

functions.name: lodepng_is_palette_type
functions.signature: unsigned lodepng_is_palette_type(const LodePNGColorMode* info)
functions.description: Returns non-zero if the color mode uses a palette (LCT_PALETTE).
requirements: info must be a valid pointer.

functions.name: lodepng_has_palette_alpha
functions.signature: unsigned lodepng_has_palette_alpha(const LodePNGColorMode* info)
functions.description: Returns non-zero only if a palette exists and any palette entry has alpha < 255.
requirements: info must be a valid pointer.
Function may loop through the palette; ensure palettesize is accurate.

functions.name: lodepng_can_have_alpha
functions.signature: unsigned lodepng_can_have_alpha(const LodePNGColorMode* info)
functions.description: Returns non-zero if the image can contain non-opaque pixels given this color mode (alpha channel present, palette with alpha, or key_defined true).
requirements: info must be a valid pointer.

functions.name: lodepng_get_raw_size
functions.signature: size_t lodepng_get_raw_size(unsigned w, unsigned h, const LodePNGColorMode* color)
functions.description: Returns the byte size required for a raw image buffer with given width, height and color mode (no scanline padding assumed for <8bpp).
requirements: w and h are pixel dimensions; must avoid overflow in caller usage.
color must be a valid pointer.
For <8 bpp images, no padding bits at end of scanlines are assumed.

functions.name: lodepng_info_init
functions.signature: void lodepng_info_init(LodePNGInfo* info)
functions.description: Initializes a LodePNGInfo struct to defaults (no allocated metadata, default header values).
requirements: info must be a valid pointer.
Call before use; reinitialization should be preceded by lodepng_info_cleanup to avoid leaks.

functions.name: lodepng_info_cleanup
functions.signature: void lodepng_info_cleanup(LodePNGInfo* info)
functions.description: Cleans up all dynamic allocations in a LodePNGInfo (text, iCCP, unknown chunks, etc.).
requirements: info must be a valid pointer.
After cleanup, pointers owned by info are invalid; must reinit before reuse.

functions.name: lodepng_info_copy
functions.signature: unsigned lodepng_info_copy(LodePNGInfo* dest, const LodePNGInfo* source)
functions.description: Deep-copies a LodePNGInfo from source to dest, including metadata and unknown chunks. Returns 0 on success or error code.
requirements: dest and source must be valid pointers.
Caller must later cleanup dest with lodepng_info_cleanup.
Returns error code on allocation failure.

functions.name: lodepng_add_text
functions.signature: unsigned lodepng_add_text(LodePNGInfo* info, const char* key, const char* str)
functions.description: Adds a tEXt/zTXt entry (key and text) to the PNG metadata in LodePNGInfo. Returns 0 on success or error code.
requirements: Requires LODEPNG_COMPILE_ANCILLARY_CHUNKS.
info must be initialized and valid.
key must be 1–79 characters, null-terminated; str is null-terminated and must not contain nulls per PNG spec.
Do not allocate text buffers yourself; use this API.
Returns error code on allocation failure or invalid input.

functions.name: lodepng_clear_text
functions.signature: void lodepng_clear_text(LodePNGInfo* info)
functions.description: Clears all non-international text chunks (tEXt/zTXt) stored in LodePNGInfo.
requirements: Requires LODEPNG_COMPILE_ANCILLARY_CHUNKS.
info must be valid.
Frees associated allocations; subsequent access requires re-adding text.

functions.name: lodepng_add_itext
functions.signature: unsigned lodepng_add_itext(LodePNGInfo* info, const char* key, const char* langtag, const char* transkey, const char* str)
functions.description: Adds an iTXt entry (key, language tag, translated key, UTF-8 text) to LodePNGInfo. Returns 0 on success or error code.
requirements: Requires LODEPNG_COMPILE_ANCILLARY_CHUNKS.
info must be initialized and valid.
All strings are null-terminated; keys must be 1–79 characters; contents must follow PNG/iTXt constraints.
Do not allocate these buffers manually; use this API.
Returns error code on allocation failure or invalid input.

functions.name: lodepng_clear_itext
functions.signature: void lodepng_clear_itext(LodePNGInfo* info)
functions.description: Clears all international text chunks (iTXt) stored in LodePNGInfo.
requirements: Requires LODEPNG_COMPILE_ANCILLARY_CHUNKS.
info must be valid.

functions.name: lodepng_set_icc
functions.signature: unsigned lodepng_set_icc(LodePNGInfo* info, const char* name, const unsigned char* profile, unsigned profile_size)
functions.description: Sets the iCCP chunk (ICC profile) metadata on the image. Copies name and profile bytes into LodePNGInfo. Returns 0 on success.
requirements: Requires LODEPNG_COMPILE_ANCILLARY_CHUNKS.
info must be valid and initialized.
name must be 1–79 bytes, null-terminated.
profile points to profile bytes of size profile_size; caller retains ownership of input.
PNG spec requires 'RGB' profiles for non-gray images and 'GRAY' profiles for gray images; encoder may error if mismatch with requested color type (especially with auto_convert disabled).
If setting iCCP, consider also providing matching gAMA and cHRM for best practice.
Returns error code on allocation failure or invalid input.

functions.name: lodepng_clear_icc
functions.signature: void lodepng_clear_icc(LodePNGInfo* info)
functions.description: Removes and deallocates the iCCP (ICC profile) metadata from LodePNGInfo.
requirements: Requires LODEPNG_COMPILE_ANCILLARY_CHUNKS.
info must be valid.

functions.name: lodepng_convert
functions.signature: unsigned lodepng_convert(unsigned char* out, const unsigned char* in, const LodePNGColorMode* mode_out, const LodePNGColorMode* mode_in, unsigned w, unsigned h)
functions.description: Converts a raw image buffer from mode_in to mode_out. Output buffer must be preallocated to (w*h*bpp_out+7)/8 bytes. Returns 0 on success or error if conversion is unsupported.
requirements: out must point to a buffer of size at least (w*h*lodepng_get_bpp(mode_out)+7)/8 bytes.
in must point to at least (w*h*lodepng_get_bpp(mode_in)+7)/8 bytes of source data with no end-of-scanline padding for <8bpp.
mode_out and mode_in must be valid pointers to color modes; only supported conversions will succeed.
For 16-bit per channel data, big-endian byte order is used.
Returns LodePNG error code if conversion not supported or other errors.

functions.name: lodepng_decoder_settings_init
functions.signature: void lodepng_decoder_settings_init(LodePNGDecoderSettings* settings)
functions.description: Initializes a LodePNGDecoderSettings struct with default options for PNG/zlib decoding, including CRC handling and color conversion flags.
requirements: settings must be a valid pointer to LodePNGDecoderSettings.

functions.name: lodepng_color_stats_init
functions.signature: void lodepng_color_stats_init(LodePNGColorStats* stats)
functions.description: Initializes a LodePNGColorStats structure for collecting color usage statistics over an image.
requirements: stats must be a valid pointer to LodePNGColorStats.

functions.name: lodepng_compute_color_stats
functions.signature: unsigned lodepng_compute_color_stats(LodePNGColorStats* stats, const unsigned char* image, unsigned w, unsigned h, const LodePNGColorMode* mode_in)
functions.description: Analyzes raw image data to fill LodePNGColorStats (e.g., palette suitability, bit depth, alpha usage). Returns 0 on success or error code.
requirements: stats must be initialized and valid.
image must contain at least w*h*(bytes per pixel of mode_in) bytes.
mode_in must describe the layout of the raw input data.
Returns LodePNG error code (e.g., allocation failure).

functions.name: lodepng_encoder_settings_init
functions.signature: void lodepng_encoder_settings_init(LodePNGEncoderSettings* settings)
functions.description: Initializes a LodePNGEncoderSettings struct with default encoder options (auto color selection, filter strategy, zlib settings).
requirements: settings must be a valid pointer to LodePNGEncoderSettings.

functions.name: lodepng_state_init
functions.signature: void lodepng_state_init(LodePNGState* state)
functions.description: Initializes a LodePNGState with default decoder/encoder settings and empty info structures.
requirements: state must be a valid pointer to LodePNGState.

functions.name: lodepng_state_cleanup
functions.signature: void lodepng_state_cleanup(LodePNGState* state)
functions.description: Cleans up allocations and internal state within a LodePNGState (info structures, etc.).
requirements: state must be a valid pointer.
Do not use fields that were freed without reinitialization.

functions.name: lodepng_state_copy
functions.signature: void lodepng_state_copy(LodePNGState* dest, const LodePNGState* source)
functions.description: Copies the complete LodePNGState, including settings and info structures, from source to dest.
requirements: dest and source must be valid pointers.
dest will receive deep copies; later cleanup with lodepng_state_cleanup is required to free allocations.

functions.name: lodepng_decode
functions.signature: unsigned lodepng_decode(unsigned char** out, unsigned* w, unsigned* h, LodePNGState* state, const unsigned char* in, size_t insize)
functions.description: Decodes a PNG from memory using a provided LodePNGState to customize settings and obtain detailed image info. Allocates *out and writes dimensions. Returns 0 on success or error code.
requirements: state must be initialized and valid; its decoder and info_raw settings control output and conversion.
out, w, h must be valid pointers; *out will be allocated and must be freed by caller.
in must point to PNG data; insize its size.
Returns LodePNG error code on failure.

functions.name: lodepng_inspect
functions.signature: unsigned lodepng_inspect(unsigned* w, unsigned* h, LodePNGState* state, const unsigned char* in, size_t insize)
functions.description: Parses only the PNG IHDR header from memory to retrieve width, height and color information. Stores results in state->info_png. Returns 0 on success.
requirements: w, h, and state must be valid pointers; state must be initialized.
in must point to PNG file bytes; insize its size.
Only IHDR and minimal information is read; no pixel data is decoded.
Returns LodePNG error code on invalid/corrupt headers.

functions.name: lodepng_inspect_chunk
functions.signature: unsigned lodepng_inspect_chunk(LodePNGState* state, size_t pos, const unsigned char* in, size_t insize)
functions.description: Reads and parses a single non-IHDR metadata chunk at the given position in the PNG data, updating fields in state->info_png. Returns 0 on success; ignores unsupported/non-metadata chunks without error.
requirements: state must be initialized and filled by a prior lodepng_inspect call so IHDR is known.
&in[pos] must point to the first byte of a PNG chunk (its 4-byte length field).
If PLTE is present, it must be inspected before tRNS or bKGD for correct interpretation.
in must be the entire PNG file buffer; insize its size.
Returns LodePNG error code on parsing failure for supported chunks.

functions.name: lodepng_encode
functions.signature: unsigned lodepng_encode(unsigned char** out, size_t* outsize, const unsigned char* image, unsigned w, unsigned h, LodePNGState* state)
functions.description: Encodes raw pixel data to a PNG in memory using a provided LodePNGState to control encoder settings. Allocates *out and writes size to *outsize. Returns 0 on success.
requirements: state must be initialized and encoder settings configured as desired.
out and outsize must be valid; *out is allocated and must be freed by caller.
image must provide at least w*h*(bytes per pixel of state->info_raw) bytes in the format described by state->info_raw.
w and h are pixel dimensions.
Returns LodePNG error code on failure.

functions.name: lodepng_chunk_length
functions.signature: unsigned lodepng_chunk_length(const unsigned char* chunk)
functions.description: Reads and returns the 4-byte big-endian length of the chunk's data field from a pointer to the start of a PNG chunk. Total chunk size is length+12 bytes.
requirements: chunk must point to the first byte of a PNG chunk (its length field).
At least 4 readable bytes must be available at chunk.
If the returned value is very large relative to the buffer, the PNG may be corrupt; caller must bounds-check.

functions.name: lodepng_chunk_type
functions.signature: void lodepng_chunk_type(char type[5], const unsigned char* chunk)
functions.description: Copies the 4-byte chunk type into a 5-byte null-terminated ASCII string from a pointer to a PNG chunk header.
requirements: type must point to a buffer of at least 5 bytes.
chunk must point to the start of a PNG chunk (length field position).
Caller must ensure chunk has at least 8 bytes accessible to read the type.

functions.name: lodepng_chunk_type_equals
functions.signature: unsigned char lodepng_chunk_type_equals(const unsigned char* chunk, const char* type)
functions.description: Returns non-zero if the chunk's 4-byte type matches the provided 4-character string.
requirements: chunk must point to the start of a PNG chunk (at least 8 bytes readable).
type must be a 4-character string (can be provided as char[5] with null terminator).

functions.name: lodepng_chunk_ancillary
functions.signature: unsigned char lodepng_chunk_ancillary(const unsigned char* chunk)
functions.description: Returns 1 if the chunk type is ancillary (first type byte lowercase), 0 if critical.
requirements: chunk must point to the start of a PNG chunk with at least 8 bytes readable.

functions.name: lodepng_chunk_private
functions.signature: unsigned char lodepng_chunk_private(const unsigned char* chunk)
functions.description: Returns 1 if the chunk type is private (second type byte lowercase), 0 if public.
requirements: chunk must point to the start of a PNG chunk with at least 8 bytes readable.

functions.name: lodepng_chunk_safetocopy
functions.signature: unsigned char lodepng_chunk_safetocopy(const unsigned char* chunk)
functions.description: Returns 1 if the chunk is safe to copy (fourth type byte lowercase), 0 if unsafe to copy.
requirements: chunk must point to the start of a PNG chunk with at least 8 bytes readable.

functions.name: lodepng_chunk_data
functions.signature: unsigned char* lodepng_chunk_data(unsigned char* chunk)
functions.description: Returns a pointer to the data payload of the PNG chunk given a pointer to its header (length field).
requirements: chunk must point to the start of a PNG chunk with at least 8 bytes readable to skip length and type.
Returned pointer must not be dereferenced beyond the chunk's data length.

functions.name: lodepng_chunk_data_const
functions.signature: const unsigned char* lodepng_chunk_data_const(const unsigned char* chunk)
functions.description: Const-qualified version returning a pointer to the chunk's data payload given a pointer to its header.
requirements: chunk must point to the start of a PNG chunk with at least 8 bytes readable.
Caller must ensure buffer bounds when using returned pointer.

functions.name: lodepng_chunk_check_crc
functions.signature: unsigned lodepng_chunk_check_crc(const unsigned char* chunk)
functions.description: Verifies the CRC of the given PNG chunk. Returns 0 if CRC is correct, 1 if incorrect.
requirements: chunk must point to the start of a complete PNG chunk (length, type, data, CRC) within accessible memory.
Caller must supply correct bounds; function assumes the full chunk is readable.

functions.name: lodepng_chunk_generate_crc
functions.signature: void lodepng_chunk_generate_crc(unsigned char* chunk)
functions.description: Computes and writes the correct CRC into the last 4 bytes of the given PNG chunk.
requirements: chunk must point to a complete, writable PNG chunk (length, type, data, CRC space).
Caller must ensure the provided buffer is large enough (length+12 bytes).

functions.name: lodepng_chunk_next
functions.signature: unsigned char* lodepng_chunk_next(unsigned char* chunk, unsigned char* end)
functions.description: Returns a pointer to the start of the next PNG chunk when given a pointer to a current chunk (or PNG magic header). If at/beyond end or corrupt, may return end or beyond.
requirements: chunk must either point to the start of a chunk (length field) or to the first byte of the PNG file (magic header), in which case it skips the header.
end must point one past the last byte of the PNG buffer; caller must provide correct bounds.
Caller must handle cases where returned pointer is >= end (no more chunks or corruption).

functions.name: lodepng_chunk_next_const
functions.signature: const unsigned char* lodepng_chunk_next_const(const unsigned char* chunk, const unsigned char* end)
functions.description: Const-qualified iterator to the next PNG chunk given current chunk (or PNG header). Behaves like lodepng_chunk_next.
requirements: chunk and end must be valid buffer bounds as described for lodepng_chunk_next.
Caller must handle reaching or exceeding end.

functions.name: lodepng_chunk_find
functions.signature: unsigned char* lodepng_chunk_find(unsigned char* chunk, unsigned char* end, const char type[5])
functions.description: Finds the first chunk with the given 4-letter type in range [chunk, end). Returns NULL if not found.
requirements: chunk must point to the start of a chunk or PNG header; end must be the buffer end pointer.
type must be a 4-character string (may be provided as char[5]).
Caller must ensure the buffer contains valid PNG chunk structure to avoid overruns.

functions.name: lodepng_chunk_find_const
functions.signature: const unsigned char* lodepng_chunk_find_const(const unsigned char* chunk, const unsigned char* end, const char type[5])
functions.description: Const-qualified version of lodepng_chunk_find that searches for a chunk by type.
requirements: Same as lodepng_chunk_find, but with const pointers.

functions.name: lodepng_chunk_append
functions.signature: unsigned lodepng_chunk_append(unsigned char** out, size_t* outsize, const unsigned char* chunk)
functions.description: Appends an existing chunk (including its header) to a PNG data buffer, reallocating the buffer and updating out/outsize. Returns 0 on success.
requirements: out and outsize must describe a heap-allocated buffer or be {NULL,0}; function reallocates as needed; caller must free(*out).
chunk must point to a complete PNG chunk beginning at its length field.
Returns LodePNG error code on allocation failure.

functions.name: lodepng_chunk_create
functions.signature: unsigned lodepng_chunk_create(unsigned char** out, size_t* outsize, unsigned length, const char* type, const unsigned char* data)
functions.description: Creates a new PNG chunk with the given length, 4-letter type and data and appends it to the output buffer, growing it. Returns 0 on success.
requirements: out/outsize must describe a heap-allocated buffer or be {NULL,0}; caller must free(*out) later.
type must be a 4-letter ASCII string (not null-terminated within the chunk).
data must point to at least 'length' bytes of payload (may be NULL if length==0).
Returns LodePNG error code on allocation failure.

functions.name: lodepng_crc32
functions.signature: unsigned lodepng_crc32(const unsigned char* buf, size_t len)
functions.description: Computes and returns the CRC32 of the given buffer, as used for PNG chunk CRCs.
requirements: buf must point to at least len bytes of data.

functions.name: lodepng_inflate
functions.signature: unsigned lodepng_inflate(unsigned char** out, size_t* outsize, const unsigned char* in, size_t insize, const LodePNGDecompressSettings* settings)
functions.description: Decompresses raw DEFLATE data (inflate) into a newly allocated buffer. Returns 0 on success; caller must free(*out).
requirements: Requires LODEPNG_COMPILE_DECODER.
out/outsize must be valid; *out will be allocated or reallocated; caller frees it.
in must point to compressed DEFLATE data; insize its size.
settings controls decompression behavior (e.g., adler/nlen ignore flags).
Returns LodePNG error code on failure.

functions.name: lodepng_zlib_decompress
functions.signature: unsigned lodepng_zlib_decompress(unsigned char** out, size_t* outsize, const unsigned char* in, size_t insize, const LodePNGDecompressSettings* settings)
functions.description: Decompresses zlib-formatted data to a newly allocated buffer, appending to existing buffer if provided. Returns 0 on success.
requirements: Requires LODEPNG_COMPILE_DECODER.
Either (*out==NULL and *outsize==0) or (*out points to a valid buffer and *outsize is its size); function appends and reallocates.
in must be zlib data; insize its size.
Caller must free(*out).
Returns LodePNG error code.

functions.name: lodepng_zlib_compress
functions.signature: unsigned lodepng_zlib_compress(unsigned char** out, size_t* outsize, const unsigned char* in, size_t insize, const LodePNGCompressSettings* settings)
functions.description: Compresses data using zlib (deflate plus zlib header/trailer), appending to or allocating the output buffer. Returns 0 on success.
requirements: Requires LODEPNG_COMPILE_ENCODER.
Either (*out==NULL and *outsize==0) or (*out points to a valid buffer and *outsize is its size).
in must point to insize bytes to compress.
Caller must free(*out) after use.
Returns LodePNG error code.

functions.name: lodepng_huffman_code_lengths
functions.signature: unsigned lodepng_huffman_code_lengths(unsigned* lengths, const unsigned* frequencies, size_t numcodes, unsigned maxbitlen)
functions.description: Computes length-limited Huffman code lengths for the given symbol frequency table. Exposed mainly for testing; used internally by deflate. Returns 0 on success.
requirements: Requires LODEPNG_COMPILE_ENCODER.
lengths must point to an array of at least numcodes elements to receive bit lengths.
frequencies must point to an array of numcodes frequencies.
maxbitlen sets maximum code length per RFC 1951 constraints.
Returns error code on failure.

functions.name: lodepng_deflate
functions.signature: unsigned lodepng_deflate(unsigned char** out, size_t* outsize, const unsigned char* in, size_t insize, const LodePNGCompressSettings* settings)
functions.description: Compresses a buffer using raw DEFLATE (RFC 1951) and allocates/appends to out. Returns 0 on success.
requirements: Requires LODEPNG_COMPILE_ENCODER.
out/outsize usage same as zlib_compress; caller must free(*out).
in must point to insize bytes to compress.
settings controls deflate parameters (window, matches, etc.).
Returns LodePNG error code.

functions.name: lodepng_load_file
functions.signature: unsigned lodepng_load_file(unsigned char** out, size_t* outsize, const char* filename)
functions.description: Loads an entire file from disk into memory, allocating *out and writing its size to *outsize. Returns 0 on success.
requirements: Requires LODEPNG_COMPILE_DISK.
filename must refer to a readable file.
out/outsize must be valid; *out is allocated and must be freed by caller.
Returns LodePNG error code on failure.

functions.name: lodepng_save_file
functions.signature: unsigned lodepng_save_file(const unsigned char* buffer, size_t buffersize, const char* filename)
functions.description: Writes the given buffer to a file on disk, overwriting if it exists. Returns 0 on success.

out is resized to hold PNG data.

functions.signature: lodepng::State::State(const lodepng::State& other)

functions.signature: lodepng::State::~State()

functions.signature: lodepng::State& lodepng::State::operator=(const lodepng::State& other)

functions.name: get_opencl_c_code
functions.signature: string get_opencl_c_code();
functions.description: Returns the OpenCL C kernel source code as a single string. Implemented elsewhere (kernel.hpp). Typical usage is to feed this source to Device's program build.
requirements: Must return syntactically correct OpenCL C compatible with the target device's OpenCL C version.
Returned code should define any kernels later referenced by Kernel constructors (names must match).

functions.name: print_device_info
functions.signature: inline void print_device_info(const Device_Info& d);
functions.description: Prints formatted information about an OpenCL device (name, vendor, driver, OpenCL version, compute/memory characteristics).
requirements: Argument d must reference a valid, initialized Device_Info struct.

functions.name: get_devices
functions.signature: inline vector<Device_Info> get_devices(const bool print_info=true);
functions.description: Enumerates all OpenCL platforms and devices, building a Device_Info for each. Optionally prints a summary list. Exits the process if no devices are found.
requirements: OpenCL ICD/runtime must be installed and discoverable.
Caller should be aware the function may print messages and may call exit(1) if no devices are available.
If print_info is true, the function prints a compact device list to stdout.

functions.name: select_device_with_most_flops
functions.signature: inline Device_Info select_device_with_most_flops(const vector<Device_Info>& devices=get_devices());
functions.description: Selects and returns the Device_Info with the highest estimated FP32 TFLOPs/s from the given list (or all devices if not provided).
requirements: devices must be non-empty; if omitted, relies on get_devices(), which may exit the process if none are available.

functions.name: select_device_with_most_memory
functions.signature: inline Device_Info select_device_with_most_memory(const vector<Device_Info>& devices=get_devices());
functions.description: Selects and returns the Device_Info with the largest reported global memory capacity (in MB) from the given list (or all devices if not provided).
requirements: devices must be non-empty; if omitted, relies on get_devices(), which may exit the process if none are available.

functions.name: select_device_with_id
functions.signature: inline Device_Info select_device_with_id(const uint id, const vector<Device_Info>& devices=get_devices());
functions.description: Returns the Device_Info with the specified ID from the provided or discovered device list. Prints an error and returns devices[0] if the ID is invalid (code path not expected to execute).
requirements: id must be less than devices.size().
devices must be non-empty; if omitted, relies on get_devices(), which may exit the process if none are available.

functions.name: Device::Device
functions.signature: inline Device::Device(const Device_Info& info, const string& opencl_c_code=get_opencl_c_code());
functions.description: Constructs a Device wrapper around the provided Device_Info, creates a command queue, builds an OpenCL Program from the provided source (augmented with capability defines), and marks the object initialized.
requirements: info must describe a valid OpenCL device and context.
opencl_c_code must compile for the device with options: -cl-std=CL<info.opencl_c_version> and others; otherwise a build error is reported.
The OpenCL runtime must support creating a command queue and building programs for the given device.
If PTX or LOG macros are defined, the process may write files under bin/.

functions.name: Device::barrier
functions.signature: inline void Device::barrier(const vector<Event>* event_waitlist=nullptr, Event* event_returned=nullptr);
functions.description: Enqueues a barrier with an optional wait list on the device's command queue.
requirements: This Device must be initialized (is_initialized() == true).
If provided, event_waitlist must point to valid cl::Event objects associated with this device/context.
event_returned, if non-null, receives the barrier event.

functions.name: Device::finish_queue
functions.signature: inline void Device::finish_queue();
functions.description: Blocks until all previously enqueued commands on the device's command queue have completed.
requirements: This Device must be initialized.

functions.name: Device::get_cl_context
functions.signature: inline cl::Context Device::get_cl_context() const;
functions.description: Returns the underlying OpenCL context associated with the device.
requirements: This Device should be initialized; otherwise the returned context may be default-constructed.

functions.name: Device::get_cl_program
functions.signature: inline cl::Program Device::get_cl_program() const;
functions.description: Returns the compiled OpenCL program associated with this Device.
requirements: Device must be initialized and program build must have succeeded for a usable program.

functions.name: Device::get_cl_queue
functions.signature: inline cl::CommandQueue Device::get_cl_queue() const;
functions.description: Returns the OpenCL command queue associated with this Device.
requirements: Device must be initialized.

functions.name: Device::is_initialized
functions.signature: inline bool Device::is_initialized() const;
functions.description: Indicates whether this Device object has been successfully initialized (queue and program created).

functions.name: Memory::Memory
functions.signature: template<typename T> inline Memory<T>::Memory(Device& device, const ulong N, const uint dimensions=1u, const bool allocate_host=true, const bool allocate_device=true, const T value=(T)0, const bool allow_zero_copy=true);
functions.description: Allocates a host buffer (optionally) and a device buffer (optionally) for N elements and 'dimensions' vector width of type T. Initializes contents to 'value'. May use zero-copy on CPUs/iGPUs when allowed and possible.
requirements: device must be initialized (device.is_initialized()==true).
N*dimensions must be > 0.
If zero-copy is allowed and chosen, host allocation is aligned and sized as required internally; for external zero-copy conditions see other constructor.
May throw/abort via print_error if device memory limits are exceeded or allocation fails.

functions.name: Memory::~Memory
functions.signature: template<typename T> inline Memory<T>::~Memory();
functions.description: Destructor; releases host and device buffers and updates device memory accounting.
requirements: Caller must ensure no outstanding device operations are using the buffers at destruction time.

functions.name: Memory::operator=
functions.signature: template<typename T> inline Memory<T>& Memory<T>::operator=(Memory<T>&& memory) noexcept;
functions.description: Move assignment operator. Transfers ownership of host and device buffers and associated state from 'memory', releasing any existing buffers held by this object.
requirements: Self-assignment with the same object should be avoided for clarity.
Source 'memory' becomes partially empty (moved-from) after this operation.

functions.name: Memory::exchange_host_buffer
functions.signature: template<typename T> inline T* const Memory<T>::exchange_host_buffer(T* const host_buffer);
functions.description: Atomically replaces the internal host_buffer pointer with the provided one and returns the old pointer. Does not transfer ownership semantics beyond raw pointer swap.
requirements: Provided host_buffer must be valid for at least N*dimensions elements if the object expects to use it.
Caller is responsible for freeing the returned old pointer if it was heap-allocated and owned externally.

functions.name: Memory::exchange_host_buffer_unaligned
functions.signature: template<typename T> inline T* const Memory<T>::exchange_host_buffer_unaligned(T* const host_buffer_unaligned);
functions.description: Replaces the internal unaligned host buffer pointer (used for alignment adjustments) and returns the old pointer.
requirements: Pointer should be compatible with the aligned host_buffer management strategy used by the class.
Caller assumes ownership of the returned old pointer and must delete[] it if appropriate.

functions.name: Memory::add_host_buffer
functions.signature: template<typename T> inline void Memory<T>::add_host_buffer();
functions.description: Allocates and attaches a new host buffer, initializes it with the current device contents, for objects that already have a device buffer but no host buffer.
requirements: device_buffer must exist and host_buffer must not exist; otherwise an error is reported.
The object must be associated with a valid Device (created via a constructor that stored 'device').

functions.name: Memory::add_device_buffer
functions.signature: template<typename T> inline void Memory<T>::add_device_buffer(const bool allow_zero_copy=true);
functions.description: Allocates and attaches a device buffer for objects that already have a host buffer but no device buffer. Copies host contents to the device. May enable zero-copy when possible.
requirements: host_buffer must exist and device_buffer must not exist; otherwise an error is reported.
Associated Device must be valid and initialized.
May fail if allocation exceeds device limits.

functions.name: Memory::delete_host_buffer
functions.signature: template<typename T> inline void Memory<T>::delete_host_buffer();
functions.description: Releases the host buffer. If the host buffer was externally provided, only detaches the pointer without freeing it.
requirements: If the host buffer was externally provided, the caller remains responsible for lifetime management.
If device buffer also does not exist after this call, internal size state resets to empty.

functions.name: Memory::delete_device_buffer
functions.signature: template<typename T> inline void Memory<T>::delete_device_buffer();
functions.description: Releases the device buffer and updates device memory accounting.
requirements: No in-flight commands should be using the buffer when deleting.
If host buffer also does not exist after this call, internal size state resets to empty.

functions.name: Memory::delete_buffers
functions.signature: template<typename T> inline void Memory<T>::delete_buffers();
functions.description: Convenience that deletes both device and host buffers, resetting the object to an empty state.
requirements: See delete_host_buffer and delete_device_buffer requirements.

functions.name: Memory::reset
functions.signature: template<typename T> inline void Memory<T>::reset(const T value=(T)0);
functions.description: Fills the host buffer with the given value and writes it to the device (unless zero-copy, where the host buffer is already the backing storage).
requirements: Host buffer must exist to fill values.
If device buffer exists and not zero-copy, a write to device is enqueued (may block by default).

functions.name: Memory::length
functions.signature: template<typename T> inline const ulong Memory<T>::length() const;
functions.description: Returns the logical length N (number of elements per dimension).

functions.name: Memory::dimensions
functions.signature: template<typename T> inline const uint Memory<T>::dimensions() const;
functions.description: Returns the number of vector dimensions d for this buffer.

functions.name: Memory::range
functions.signature: template<typename T> inline const ulong Memory<T>::range() const;
functions.description: Returns the total number of elements (N*d).

functions.name: Memory::capacity
functions.signature: template<typename T> inline const ulong Memory<T>::capacity() const;
functions.description: Returns the total capacity in bytes (N*d*sizeof(T)).

functions.name: Memory::data
functions.signature: template<typename T> inline T* const Memory<T>::data();
functions.description: Returns a mutable pointer to the host buffer.
requirements: Host buffer must exist.

functions.name: Memory::operator()
functions.signature: template<typename T> inline T* const Memory<T>::operator()();
functions.description: Returns a mutable pointer to the host buffer (call operator).
requirements: Host buffer must exist.

functions.name: Memory::operator[]
functions.signature: template<typename T> inline T& Memory<T>::operator[](const ulong i);
functions.description: Indexed mutable access to the i-th element of the host buffer (array-of-structures layout across dimensions).
requirements: Host buffer must exist.
i must be less than range() to avoid out-of-bounds access.

functions.name: Memory::read_from_device
functions.signature: template<typename T> inline void Memory<T>::read_from_device(const bool blocking=true, const vector<Event>* event_waitlist=nullptr, Event* event_returned=nullptr);
functions.description: Reads the full device buffer into the host buffer. No-op if zero-copy is active.
requirements: Both host and device buffers must exist.
If zero-copy is in use, this does nothing.
If provided, event_waitlist must contain events compatible with this queue.

functions.name: Memory::read_from_device
functions.signature: template<typename T> inline void Memory<T>::read_from_device(const ulong offset, const ulong length, const bool blocking=true, const vector<Event>* event_waitlist=nullptr, Event* event_returned=nullptr);
functions.description: Reads a subrange [offset, offset+length) from the device buffer into the host buffer (clamped to valid range). No-op if zero-copy.
requirements: Both host and device buffers must exist.
Offset and length are clamped internally; caller should choose values within range() for intended behavior.

functions.name: Memory::write_to_device
functions.signature: template<typename T> inline void Memory<T>::write_to_device(const bool blocking=true, const vector<Event>* event_waitlist=nullptr, Event* event_returned=nullptr);
functions.description: Writes the full host buffer to the device buffer. No-op if zero-copy is active.
requirements: Both host and device buffers must exist.
If zero-copy is in use, this does nothing.
If provided, event_waitlist must contain events compatible with this queue.

functions.name: Memory::write_to_device
functions.signature: template<typename T> inline void Memory<T>::write_to_device(const ulong offset, const ulong length, const bool blocking=true, const vector<Event>* event_waitlist=nullptr, Event* event_returned=nullptr);
functions.description: Writes a subrange [offset, offset+length) from the host buffer to the device buffer (clamped to valid range). No-op if zero-copy.
requirements: Both host and device buffers must exist.
Offset and length are clamped internally; caller should choose values within range() for intended behavior.

functions.name: Memory::read_from_device_1d
functions.signature: template<typename T> inline void Memory<T>::read_from_device_1d(const ulong x0, const ulong x1, const int dimension=-1, const bool blocking=true, const vector<Event>* event_waitlist=nullptr, Event* event_returned=nullptr);

dimension must be -1 for all or a valid dimension index in [0, d).

functions.name: Memory::write_to_device_1d
functions.signature: template<typename T> inline void Memory<T>::write_to_device_1d(const ulong x0, const ulong x1, const int dimension=-1, const bool blocking=true, const vector<Event>* event_waitlist=nullptr, Event* event_returned=nullptr);
functions.description: Writes a 1D slice [x0, x1) from host to device for either all vector dimensions or a specific dimension. Optionally blocks after enqueues.
requirements: Both host and device buffers must exist.
x0 and x1 define the range; effective offsets are clamped to valid bounds.
dimension must be -1 for all or a valid dimension index in [0, d).

functions.name: Memory::read_from_device_2d
functions.signature: template<typename T> inline void Memory<T>::read_from_device_2d(const ulong x0, const ulong x1, const ulong y0, const ulong y1, const ulong Nx, const ulong Ny, const int dimension=-1, const bool blocking=true, const vector<Event>* event_waitlist=nullptr, Event* event_returned=nullptr);

functions.name: Memory::write_to_device_2d
functions.signature: template<typename T> inline void Memory<T>::write_to_device_2d(const ulong x0, const ulong x1, const ulong y0, const ulong y1, const ulong Nx, const ulong Ny, const int dimension=-1, const bool blocking=true, const vector<Event>* event_waitlist=nullptr, Event* event_returned=nullptr);
functions.description: Writes a 2D subdomain from host to device for specified x and y ranges, given row/plane sizes Nx and Ny. Supports all or a single dimension.
requirements: Both host and device buffers must exist.
Indices are clamped; caller should provide valid x/y ranges within domain.
Nx and Ny must match the layout used when reading the buffer.

functions.name: Memory::read_from_device_3d
functions.signature: template<typename T> inline void Memory<T>::read_from_device_3d(const ulong x0, const ulong x1, const ulong y0, const ulong y1, const ulong z0, const ulong z1, const ulong Nx, const ulong Ny, const ulong Nz, const int dimension=-1, const bool blocking=true, const vector<Event>* event_waitlist=nullptr, Event* event_returned=nullptr);

functions.name: Memory::write_to_device_3d
functions.signature: template<typename T> inline void Memory<T>::write_to_device_3d(const ulong x0, const ulong x1, const ulong y0, const ulong y1, const ulong z0, const ulong z1, const ulong Nx, const ulong Ny, const ulong Nz, const int dimension=-1, const bool blocking=true, const vector<Event>* event_waitlist=nullptr, Event* event_returned=nullptr);

Indices are clamped; caller should provide valid x/y/z ranges within domain.
Nx, Ny, Nz must reflect the buffer's logical layout.

functions.name: Memory::enqueue_read_from_device
functions.signature: template<typename T> inline void Memory<T>::enqueue_read_from_device(const ulong offset, const ulong length, const vector<Event>* event_waitlist=nullptr, Event* event_returned=nullptr);
functions.description: Non-blocking enqueue of a subrange read from device to host.
requirements: Both host and device buffers must exist unless zero-copy (no-op).

functions.name: Memory::enqueue_write_to_device
functions.signature: template<typename T> inline void Memory<T>::enqueue_write_to_device(const vector<Event>* event_waitlist=nullptr, Event* event_returned=nullptr);
functions.description: Non-blocking enqueue of a full-buffer write from host to device (equivalent to write_to_device with blocking=false).

functions.name: Units::set_m_kg_s
functions.signature: void Units::set_m_kg_s(const float x, const float u, const float rho, const float si_x, const float si_u, const float si_rho)
functions.description: Initializes the internal length (m), mass (kg), and time (s) unit scales from corresponding simulation and SI reference values: length x↔si_x, velocity u↔si_u, density rho↔si_rho. Prints a brief conversion summary.

x must be non-zero (used as divisor).
si_u must be non-zero (used as divisor).
rho must be non-zero if si_rho is non-zero (used as divisor to set unit_kg).
si_x, si_u, si_rho should be finite real numbers.
Typical physical inputs should be positive (length, velocity magnitude, density), although positivity is not programmatically enforced.

requirements: Must be called before any SI↔simulation conversion methods to ensure correct scaling.
m, kg, s must be non-zero finite values (used as divisors in conversions).

functions.name: Units::set_m_kg_s_K
